items.name: Brisket plate
items.description: Sliced brisket with sides on the lakefront patio — the park's one planned-stop meal.
items.verdict: The best lunch at Great Adventure by a comfortable margin. Get the plate, sit on the patio, watch Nitro run.

items.name: Funnel cake
items.description: Fresh-fried funnel cake with powdered sugar or strawberries, eaten at the lake railing.
items.verdict: Theme-park tradition priced like a theme park. Share one at close and call it the day's dessert.

items.name: Churro
items.description: Cinnamon-sugar churro from the midway carts — the walk-to-El-Toro snack.
items.verdict: Portable, cheap-ish, and eaten in motion. The correct fuel for the rope-drop walk.
